methods.name: Quest skip to level 26
methods.note: Monk's Friend, Icthlarin's Little Helper, Enlightened Journey and the Skrach Uglogwee part of Recipe for Disaster give 9,000 XP, enough for level 26.

methods.name: Regular trees
methods.note: One log a tree, so much of the time goes on walking to the next. Rated on a bronze axe, free from the Woodsman tutor; a steel axe from Bob's at 6 is quicker.

methods.name: Oak trees
methods.note: Several logs a tree before it falls after 27 seconds of chopping, and faster than willows until 35. Rates assume a steel axe, mithril at 21 and adamant at 31.

methods.name: Teak trees
methods.note: Three teaks on the Isle of Souls need no quest; drop the logs. Rates assume a dragon axe from 61. A felling axe with forester's rations adds 10%.

methods.name: Teak trees (1.5-tick)
methods.note: Tick-perfect, alternating between three teaks you grew on Fossil Island. The guide's long-term rates on a dragon axe; a felling axe with rations adds 10%.

methods.name: Wintertodt
methods.note: Ironmen take Woodcutting from about 50 to 60 here while training Firemaking, then buy a rune axe at the Woodcutting Guild.

methods.name: Yews with Forestry events
methods.note: Chop yews on a Forestry world (388, 444, 487 or 510) and join the events for anima-infused bark. The guide rates it only at 99: 80,000 to 90,000 an hour.

methods.name: Blisterwood tree
methods.note: Darkmeyer tree that never runs out; a sound plays when you stop chopping. Sins of the Father only needs to be partly done. Rates assume a dragon axe.

methods.name: Sulliusceps
methods.note: Tar Swamp on Fossil Island, a swamp walk between six mushrooms. Bring antipoison and food. Numulite and fossils pay. Rates assume a dragon axe and lumberjack outfit.

methods.name: Camphor trees
methods.note: The Great Conch: Troubled Tortugans only needs to be partly done. The Sacred Grove, after The Red Reef, has a deposit box. The logs sell. Rates assume a dragon axe.

methods.name: Bloodwood trees
methods.note: Vampyrium. Wound three trees in turn with quick clicks and tap each for sap. The sap cannot be traded but makes seeking arrows. More with a crystal felling axe.

methods.name: Engorged bloodwood tree
methods.note: One tree south of the Ruined Village: a click to chop, one to drain, now and then a letvek to release. The sap cannot be traded but makes seeking arrows.

methods.name: Ironwood trees
methods.note: Sunbleak Island: 72 Sailing and an adamant helm (59 Construction) to pass the kelp. The bank chest there needs 70 Construction. Rates assume a dragon axe.

methods.name: Redwood trees
methods.note: Woodcutting Guild, which adds 7 hidden levels. Very little attention. Bank the logs at the chest for about 770 coins each, or drop them for a little more XP.

methods.name: Rosewood trees
methods.note: Drumstick Isle: 79 Sailing and an adamant keel (62 Construction). A tree lasts about 4.5 minutes and there is no bank, so drop the logs. Rates assume a dragon axe.

unverified: Quest skip to level 26: Monk's Friend 2,000, Icthlarin's Little Helper 4,000, Enlightened Journey 1,500 and the Skrach Uglogwee part of Recipe for Disaster 1,500 give 9,000 XP, level 26 at 8,740 (Quest experience rewards); renamed from 'Early quests, then trees and oaks' now that the trees and oaks have entries of their own; no hourly rate (xph 0)

Regular trees: no page rates them below 99; 6,900 is the success chart for a bronze axe (25.4% a roll at level 1; free from the Woodsman tutor) with 3.6 seconds to reach the next tree, the middle of what the guide's 12,500 to 18,750 at 99 implies; Wise Old Man's ironman table gives 7,000 for levels 1 to 15; a steel axe from level 6 would give about 11,400, above that table, so it is left to the note

Oak trees: no page rates them below 99; the bands apply the guide's 40,000 at 99 (71% of non-stop chopping where every roll succeeds) to the success chart with a steel axe at 15, mithril at 21 and adamant at 31: 13,100, 18,100 and 24,800; the Ultimate Ironman guide (rev 15232438) gives 'up to around 20,000' with a steel axe and 29,000 with an adamant one, 85% of which is 17,000 and 24,650 (steel at 30 gives 16,400 here); Wise Old Man's ironman table gives 25,000 for 15 to 35; an ironman without Auburnvale's axe shop may chop on steel to 30

Teak trees: the guide's table (34,000 at 35 to 93,000 at 99) assumes a dragon felling axe with forester's rations from 61 and a crystal felling axe from 71; it is 83 to 85% of non-stop chopping with that gear at every row, and the bands keep each row's share on a plain dragon axe: 59,100 at 61 to 80,300 at 99, within 1% of the dragon axe column the guide's own table had in March 2023 (58,600 to 80,000); the guide's 'roughly 20,000' more with Forestry events is not counted

Teak trees (1.5-tick): the guide calls its table (93,000 at 35 to 235,000 at 99, with felling axes and rations from 61 and a crystal felling axe from 71) the maximum long-term rate, and it is Wise Old Man's main table to the rounding; its version of March 2023 gave the same rows on a dragon axe (156,100 at 61 to 200,000 at 99) as what 'most players are more likely to see', under a maximum of 215,000 to 220,000; the bands are the table on a dragon axe, 157,300 at 61 to 203,000 at 99, held to Wise Old Man at 41 (114,700) and with the 50 row from 51, where that table puts it; needs the three Fossil Island hardwood patches grown with teak (35 Farming), whose trees have no depletion timer

Wintertodt: no Woodcutting rate; the ironman guide heads it levels 50 to 60, and Wise Old Man's ironman table counts levels 47 to 63 from it as no time; each bruma root gives 0.3 times the Woodcutting level

Yews with Forestry events: the guide's only figure is 80,000 to 90,000 at 99, so the entry is unrated (it was 0 below 99 and 85,000 at 99, which the guide page showed as about 85k from 60); the Forestry strategy page's rewards per event (about 2,000 XP at level 50) and 3 to 7 events an hour at a busy spot come to about 54,000 at 99 with yew chopping, so the guide's figure cannot be rebuilt

Blisterwood tree: the guide's 'up to around 69,000 prior to level 90' is 89% of non-stop chopping with a dragon axe at 89 (non-stop chopping at 62 gives only 62,300); the bands keep that share at each level and take 85%: 47,200 at 62 to 63,000 at 99; the same share with a crystal felling axe and rations at 99 gives 85,200 against the guide's 'up to 86,000'; the Ultimate Ironman guide says 'up to around 65,000' before 90, 6% under the main guide

Sulliusceps: the guide's dragon axe column (82,700 at 65 to 101,900 at 99, with the lumberjack outfit) is the success chart plus about 31 seconds' walk a mushroom at every row, one model that the Sulliuscep page and the ironman guide repeat; the strategy page, marked obsolete since December 2024, gives 55,000 to 65,000 at 65 without the outfit and about 80,000 at 75; the guide's text of 2021 said 'up to around 80,000' at 75 and 'around 97,000' at 90, which the table matches; the table was added on 21 March 2023, before forester's rations; the crystal axe column is 3% higher

Camphor trees: the guide rates them only at 99 (70,000); the bands are 85% of non-stop chopping with a dragon axe, 50,700 at 66 to 64,300 at 99, 8% under it; the camphor page's 80,000 to 85,000 at 90 is on a Forestry world with events and the group boost; the Sacred Grove's +7 boost appears only in a January 2026 blog, not on the wiki; Troubled Tortugans only needs to be partly done

Bloodwood trees: 170,000 is the midpoint of the guide's 130,000 to 210,000 with a dragon felling axe (the lower end set 'more conservative' on 5 July 2026, the top 'following testing' on 9 July); the tree page's 22 chops of about 29.7 XP and 1,360 in taps a bucket at 99 with a dragon axe, at its 90 to 100 buckets an hour, give 181,000 to 201,000 for efficient play, 85% of which is 154,000 to 171,000; no figure is tied to a level, and the chops a tree rise below 99

Engorged bloodwood tree: 59,500 is 85% of the guide's 'around 70,000'; the tree page's 21.8 buckets an hour leave about 2 seconds a cycle for its two clicks, which is attentive play rather than AFK play, and several of its statements carry citation-needed tags; no success chances are published, so it cannot be rebuilt

Ironwood trees: the guide's 'around 80,000 with a dragon axe' cannot hold at 80, where non-stop chopping with a dragon axe gives 72,800; the bands are 85% of non-stop chopping, 61,900 at 80 to 70,600 at 99, and the ironwood page's 'roughly 75,000' at 99 is 6% above; the Ultimate Ironman guide gives 'around 70,000' at 80 with a dragon axe, dropping the logs (96% of non-stop chopping); the ironman guide still has the 80,000 to 100,000 the main guide dropped on 27 July 2026 ('I can't replicate 100k/hr')

Ironwood trees and rosewood trees: Sunbleak Island needs an adamant helm (72 Sailing, 59 Construction) and Drumstick Isle an adamant keel (66 Sailing, 62 Construction); shipwrights build core parts only up to mithril, so the player builds them, and req now asks for the Construction; both are boostable, which req cannot say
Redwood trees: the guide's 55,000 to 60,000 at 90 and about 65,000 at 99 with a dragon axe hold: with the guild's +7 the chart gives 69,000 and 73,500 non-stop, 85% of which is 58,700 and 62,500

Rosewood trees: the guide's 85,000 to 90,000 is 96 to 102% of non-stop chopping with a dragon axe (88,400 at 99), so it needs better gear (it is 85% of a crystal felling axe with rations); the bands are 85% of non-stop chopping with a dragon axe, 72,000 at 92 and 75,100 at 99

Gear: every rate assumes the best ordinary axe for the level (bronze, then steel, mithril at 21, adamant at 31, rune at 41) and a plain dragon axe from 61 (94,490 coins on 15 October 2026); a dragon felling axe was 2,122,047 and needs forester's rations (46 coins each) for its 10%; an ironman still on a rune axe at 61 to 75 is about 10 to 15% slower than shown, one on adamant at 41 to 59 about 15% slower

Efficiency ceilings (Wise Old Man, 15 October 2026): main 29,000 to 15 (quests and trees), 56,000 to 35 (2-tick oaks), then 1.5-tick teaks 93,174 to 235,000; ironman 7,000 trees, 25,000 oaks, 45,000 teaks to 47, Wintertodt as no time to 63, then 1.5-tick teaks 158,600 to 194,000; every rate here is below them except bloodwood trees, 100 over the ironman table's 169,900 at 70 to 79, which predates bloodwood (no row since April 2026 names it)

Not included: 2-tick teaks (78,000 to 215,000, slower than 1.5-tick and only useful without Bone Voyage); 2-tick oaks (Wise Old Man's main 56,000, twenty levels); 1.5-tick redwoods at the Farming Guild (up to 180,000 with a crystal axe, 90 Farming, kept for the logs); willows, maples, mahogany, yews, magic trees, arctic pines, hollow trees and jatoba (each slower than teaks at the same level and axe: jatoba 28,600 against 49,800 at 41); infected roots (10 to 35 XP a cut); ironwood and rosewood grown on Fossil Island (slower than the islands, the guide says)
